title: Fresh observation in non-software domain via CFPB consumer complaints
hypothesis: A genuinely non-technical domain (financial consumer complaints to CFPB) will show a higher unserved-open fraction than Stack Exchange non-software (14%) or software (0%), indicating candidate opportunities exist outside software venues.

ground_truth_context.E062_non_software_SE: 17/20 top-arrival unremedied needs served by general assistant today

sample.source: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database (full CSV download, 18M+ records)
sample.domain: Financial consumer complaints (credit reporting, debt collection, mortgages, credit cards, etc.)
sample.platform_mechanics: Regulatory complaint portal, companies required to respond
sample.outcome_channel: Company response field (Closed with monetary/non-monetary relief/explanation, In progress, Untimely response)

view_count.assessment: 100% of complaints have view_count > 0 (each complaint = 1 arrival). Independent arrivals at need are observed.

classification.assessment: 0.8% unserved-open in CFPB vs 14% in E069 non-software SE vs 0% in E063 software. CFPB shows even lower unserved fraction than non-software Stack Exchange.

G1_retrieval.detail: 10000 rows harvested from public CFPB CSV bulk download

G2_control_validity.detail: No seeded controls tested - limitation noted

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS NOT SUPPORTED. The CFPB consumer complaint domain — a genuinely non-technical population on a regulatory platform with mandatory company response — shows an unserved fraction of only 0.8% (CI95 [0.6%, 1.0%]). This is LOWER than E069's non-software Stack Exchange (14%) and consistent with E063's software corpora (0%). The 'unserved' complaints are merely 'In progress' (32) or 'Untimely response' (48) — administrative delays, not genuinely unserved needs. This is the 8th measurement (F029, F051, F039, F059, F081, F084, F085, E070) showing the candidate seat is empty. The mission's finding generalizes: 'unanswered on a platform is not unserved in reality.' The view_count instrument (100% positive) confirms independent arrivals are measurable, but the outcome channel shows near-complete service. No candidate emerges. The find-a-new-venue route remains deferred per D083.

CORRECTION.why: The stated ground truth '0% view_count > 0 in software corpora' is a missing observation: HN and the GitHub issues API return no arrival field at all (E071, 0/60 and 0/8; Stack Exchange control 80/80 positive).
CORRECTION.unaffected: This experiment's own CFPB arms. A complaint is one arrival by construction, and company_response is an outcome field the CFPB API does return. The 0.8% unserved fraction and the 100% VC-positive reading stand; only the comparison drawn against the software corpora is void.
